goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: The final read-only audit found the native product, package, Vite/Vite+, editor, Markless, non-fork, and five established performance lanes substantially complete, but rejected release of the exact current tree. A public comparative benchmark and related documentation changed after the passing clean-room copy began, the benchmark-page unit contract is now red, the comparative entry was manually appended rather than generated by the frozen performance runner, and its three-sample unlike-workload method does not support the public same-app/29.2x/release-gate copy. The audit also found that frozen threshold anti-weakening is incomplete outside the formatter lane. Current completion is therefore not_complete until one bounded evidence-hardening Worker repairs or removes those claims, reruns performance and clean-room proof on the final source, and a fresh Judge approves it.

commands.evidence: 11/12 passed; benchmark-sections expected five h2 families while the late site source renders six.
All 46 generated files match the current documentation source, including the late comparative section.
89/89 static browser checks passed, which confirms that the late comparison is publicly rendered but does not validate its methodology.
3/3 package/site/social launch identity and pack dry-run contracts passed.
205 Rust and 12 VS Code bundled dependency licenses remained deterministic.
Board structure was healthy with only T999 active at audit time.

oracle_audit.evidence: The retained owner oracle passed, but package/documentation/benchmark sources changed after its disposable copy began, so it does not cover the exact current source tree.
179 valid pinned Markless files format/reparse/converge, 12 invalid files reject, and an installed VSIX proves activation, diagnostics, format-on-save, and a safe action without an external write.
Authored offsets, identity-safe fix/reparse, JSON/JSONC/Vite config, built-in rules, type-aware batching, and loud JavaScript-plugin rejection are directly retained.
Real-corpus convergence, checked structural lift, raw-style byte preservation, malformed rejection, and transactional writes are proven.
Vite build/dev/HMR and physical Vite+ 0.1.24/0.2.4 consumers exercise literal build/dev retransform, lint, format, and check --fix.
All four families have output/diagnostic parity and zero TSRX scan/projection proof.

oracle_audit.verdict: pass for five established lanes; fail for late comparative lane
oracle_audit.evidence: Lint, format, type-aware, Vite, and editor gates retain coherent passing reports and confidence policy. The comparative lane is not generated by run-performance, has unlike work, and has only one warmup plus three samples.
One canonical OXC Git revision is adapter-contained and tests reject mixed identities, patches, vendors, copied crates, and adapter bypasses.
Independent read-only fingerprint reproduction matches the retained Markless HEAD, combined/status hashes, and four pre-existing untracked files.
The benchmark-page unit suite is red and the site presents a non-like-for-like, non-runner-generated comparison as a frozen release gate.

blocking_findings: The current benchmark-page suite is red because the late comparative family is not represented by the freshness contract.
The passing clean-room report predates late package/documentation/benchmark source changes.
The comparative performance-report entry has a timestamp after the aggregate completion time, was manually appended, and leaves a bare string in the structured command array.
ESLint, Oxlint, and oxlint-tsrx currently run different rule/configuration, discovery, argument, and output boundaries; the paired TSX/mixed corpora are not semantically equivalent.
The public site nevertheless markets the result as the same app, roughly 29.2x faster, and one of the frozen release gates.
Only formatter thresholds have a direct anti-weakening guard; every public frozen lane needs an explicit immutable expected-budget contract.
The architecture wording overstates embedded-lift bypass for style-free dynamic-tag files, and the editor benchmark hashes the retained source rather than the exact injected measured source.
residual_risks_after_repair: Local execution proves only the host native artifact; all eight target artifacts remain a post-push hosted release-candidate gate.
JavaScript lint plugins, embedded CSS formatting, and some malformed/incomplete editor syntax remain intentionally unsupported and documented.
OXC upgrades remain deliberate and manual behind the narrow adapter boundary.
Formatter RSS at 1.143x is close to its 1.15x ceiling but passed all three coherent confidence reports.
Performance evidence is specific to the retained Apple M5 Pro host and corpus, not a universal speed promise.
goalbuddy_receipt_v1.recommended_next: Activate T035 to either make the comparative lane genuinely like-for-like and first-class in the performance oracle or remove/defer its launch claims; freeze every lane's expected thresholds, correct the two minor evidence claims, regenerate the site, and rerun the complete performance and clean-room oracles before T036 repeats the final audit.
